verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own official SDKs: an Authentication SDK for out-of-band 3D Secure, plus iOS SDKs for revealing card details and changing PINs in-app. However, the evidence shows only these feature-specific mobile and authentication SDKs, not general server-side client libraries for the issuing API (card creation and management are described as raw /paymentInstruments requests). Missing for 10: server-side language SDKs covering the core Issuing API, SDK reference and installation depth beyond the feature pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.
